context: This mirrors the observed production implementation failure: an update-or-create flow should use Optional as the decision boundary and keep creation lazy.

checklist.name: Creates requested service
checklist.description: Creates WorkpadService.java with upsertWorkpad(Card, String), the requested records, and needed imports.

checklist.name: Preserves all statuses
checklist.description: Returns missing_action_id, comment_window_incomplete, updated:id:text, and created:cardId:text in the required cases.

checklist.name: Preserves lazy create path
checklist.description: Does not execute comment-window checks or create logic when an existing workpad comment is present; uses orElseGet or an equivalent lazy branch.

checklist.name: Uses Optional update/create boundary
checklist.description: Uses the result of the workpad lookup as the update-or-create boundary, such as findFirst().map(...).orElseGet(...), with named helpers if useful.

checklist.name: No nullable or fake collection workaround
checklist.description: Does not use orElse(null) plus local null branching, Optional.stream().toList(), a list, or a loop over one Optional to unwrap the workpad.

checklist.name: No presence-check value read
checklist.description: Does not use isPresent()/isEmpty() followed by get() or orElseThrow() for ordinary workpad value reads.

checklist.name: Keeps implementation focused
checklist.description: Keeps the implementation focused on the requested update-or-create flow without unrelated abstractions, dependencies, or broad rewrites.
